claim: Knowledge can go wrong by OMISSION while every clause of its gate stays green. The GSD X ledger's six gates all detect contradiction and none detects missing coverage, so 6/6 exit 0 was compatible with a corpus 27 commits stale. Four gates close it: supersession targets resolve, supersession is acyclic, a shrink-only dependency ratchet fails in both directions, and material evidence no claim speaks about is a failure.
evidence: da7aea1 (the reconciler), 3c82c68 (the four gates). Drill 10/10 both poles: the green pole survives, three supersede mutations are caught, and skip accounting asserts exactly two repo-backed gates skip against a synthetic subject.
note: Measured and decisive: of the 12 surfaces the 21 path-naming claims were observed against, ZERO moved across the whole 27-commit delta. Dependency staleness reports CURRENT for all of them and is correct to. Coverage therefore had to be scoped to the COMPLEMENT of the claimed surfaces -- a sweep scoped TO them returns empty here and rebuilds the original defect inside its own detector.

claim: The reconciliation boundary advances to the commit that reconciled the ledger, and a commit touching only vault/datasets/gsd_x/ is bookkeeping rather than evidence.
rationale: A reconciler is one step behind itself: reconciling produces commits that are themselves uncovered, so without a bookkeeping rule the count can never reach zero and the gate would be permanently red -- which is how a gate gets switched off. Excluding the reconciler's own TOOL commits instead would be a blind spot, so those are covered by a claim (GSDX-N3A) rather than skipped.

claim: Knowledge can be wrong while nothing in it is false. A 69-claim ledger sat 27 commits stale with its gate at 6/6 exit 0, because all six clauses ask whether what is written is internally sound and none asks whether anything is missing. Contradiction detection is structurally blind to omission.
evidence: 1d1700d. Decisive measurement: of the 12 surfaces the 21 path-naming claims were observed against, zero moved across the whole delta, so dependency staleness reports CURRENT for all 21 and is correct to.
note: Five rule candidates carry their intended level and are marked PROMOTION_PENDING_CONCURRENT_WRITER: the canonical UKDL held 1,057 uncommitted rows from another producer, last written 24 seconds before the lesson. Not promoted.

claim: Canonical GSD X development is feature/knowledge-acquisition; canonical release is main at ada05e2, equal to origin/main; gsd-x and integrate/gsd-x-landing are historical and are not deleted.
rationale: The premise of three competing realities was false on measurement: both legacy branches had ZERO commits unique to main, so there was nothing to merge and a merge wave would have changed no file. main was advanced by compare-and-swap update-ref, which asserts the old value; the single-argument form is unconditional and would move main to a non-descendant. main was checked out in no worktree, so none of the 416 foreign dirty paths could be absorbed. No force, no history rewritten, no branch deleted.
